name: Stainless Algae Scraper Blade
description: A long-handled stainless razor blade for shearing hard, mature green-spot algae off glass that a magnet pad can't budge. Glass-only — the rigid blade is useless on irregular hardscape. effectiveness (0.9) + reachMm (40) are MODELLED game-tuning weights, not product specs.
notes: Steel blades scratch acrylic — glass tanks only. The most effective tool against hard mature green-spot, which nerite snails largely ignore.
